tools.name: zerogpu_health
tools.title: ZeroGPU health check
tools.description: Verifies the ZeroGPU Orchestration API is reachable and returns component status.

tools.name: zerogpu_classify_iab
tools.title: IAB content classification
tools.description: Classify text into IAB categories using the ZeroGPU edge classifier. Set enriched=true for the richer taxonomy.

tools.name: zerogpu_summarize
tools.title: Summarize text
tools.description: Summarize a passage with Google T5-small. Use for TL;DRs, meeting notes, short abstracts.

tools.name: zerogpu_classify_zero_shot
tools.title: Zero-shot label classification
tools.description: Score a text against a flat list of candidate labels using DeBERTa-v3-small NLI. Returns per-label scores.

tools.name: zerogpu_extract_entities
tools.title: Extract named entities
tools.description: Extract entities (people, places, dates, custom types) from text with GLiNER2. Provide a flat list of entity labels.

tools.name: zerogpu_extract_json
tools.title: Extract structured JSON
tools.description: Pull structured fields out of text using GLiNER2 JSON mode. Schema is grouped: keys are group names (e.g. 'contact'), values are arrays of 'field::type::desc' specs (e.g. 'name::str::Full name').

tools.name: zerogpu_classify_structured
tools.title: Schema-driven classification
tools.description: Classify text into a structured schema of label groups with GLiNER2. Use when labels have categories (not a flat list).

tools.name: zerogpu_redact_pii
tools.title: Redact PII
tools.description: Replace personally identifiable information (names, phones, emails, addresses, etc.) in text with masked placeholders using gliner-multi-pii. Pass mask='label' for [PHONE]/[EMAIL]-style tokens.

tools.name: zerogpu_extract_pii
tools.title: Extract PII
tools.description: Detect and extract personally identifiable information from text into a category map using gliner-multi-pii. Optional categories filter (e.g. ['identity','contact']) and threshold.

tools.name: zerogpu_generate_followups
tools.title: Generate follow-up questions
tools.description: Produce follow-up questions about a passage using the ZeroGPU edge follow-up model.

tools.name: zerogpu_chat
tools.title: Small-model chat
tools.description: Chat with LFM2.5-1.2B. Set thinking=true to route to the Thinking variant; reasoning trace is returned separately.
